title: Ashok Kumar v. Managing Director, Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Krishna Murari, J.; Ajay Bhanot, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to Consumer Forum under clause 7.10.
headnote: A writ challenging the licensee's rejection of a bill-correctness objection is not entertained where clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 affords a statutory remedy before the Electricity Consumer Redressal Forum. The consumer may pursue that forum if so advised.
facts: Ashok Kumar filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court challenging an order of Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Ltd. that had rejected his objection to the correctness of an electricity bill. He asked the Court to interfere with that rejection. The petition came before a Division Bench of Krishna Murari and Ajay Bhanot, JJ. The dispute concerned bill correctness after the licensee's objection-disposal order, with a statutory consumer grievance forum available under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: Where the licensee's order rejecting a consumer's objection to bill correctness is challenged in writ, the High Court will not entertain the petition because clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 provides a statutory remedy before the Electricity Consumer Redressal Forum; the writ is dismissed with liberty to avail that forum.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the electricity bill and the order rejecting the petitioner's objection
not_decided.note: Writ declined solely for the clause 7.10 forum; billing merits not examined.
